desc:
Some places are abandoned. Others are waiting to be remembered.

Beyond the quiet shores of Pantalan lies Pulo Kalag, a mysterious island where an abandoned home holds the remnants of a forgotten family.

In this Filipino-inspired cooperative survival horror adventure, explore the island, gather resources, restore a neglected home, and uncover the secrets hidden within its walls.

🌴 SURVIVE — Gather supplies, strengthen your shelter, and endure the horrors that emerge after dark.

🛠️ RESTORE — Rebuild forgotten places and uncover the stories left behind.

👻 UNCOVER — Experience unsettling encounters and mysteries inspired by Philippine folklore.

🕯️ REMEMBER — Discover forgotten belongings, piece together memories, and experience the complete Chapter 1.1 story.

⛵ TOGETHER OR ALONE — Embark on an expedition solo or with up to 3 friends. Survive as long as you wish, and decide when your story comes to an end.

But remember...

Not everything on the island
